properties.citation: Natural Earth, Geography Regions polygons, feature LIBYAN DESERT (FEATURECLA Desert, SCALERANK 3, NAME_FR « désert Libyque »), the modern name of the eastern Sahara. Dinerstein, E., Olson, D., Joshi, A., et al. (2017). An Ecoregion-Based Approach to Protecting Half the Terrestrial Realm. BioScience 67 (6), 534–545. DOI 10.1093/biosci/bix014.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the Natural Earth region polygon LIBYAN DESERT, kept inside the Sahara and west of the Nile (Natural Earth's label region runs south into the savanna to 9° N, which the Sahara clip removes); the Sahara is the union of the Ecoregions 2017 ecoregions Saharan Atlantic coastal desert, North Saharan Xeric Steppe and Woodland, West Sahara desert, East Sahara Desert, South Sahara desert, West Saharan montane xeric woodlands, East Saharan montane xeric woodlands, Tibesti-Jebel Uweinat montane xeric woodlands, Saharan halophytics, on Africa's land (Africa's land is the union of the Natural Earth Admin 0 countries whose CONTINENT is Africa); « west of the Nile » keeps, on each grid row, the cells west of the westernmost crossing of the Natural Earth rivers named Nile, El Bahr el Abyad or Bahr el Jebel; north of the river's last vertex (the delta apex near Cairo) the apex longitude is used; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. Natural Earth draws generalized regions for labelling, not surveyed limits.
